scope: Explain captured pick selection and strength of price support; do not invent football conviction
decisions: All rationale is engine-produced from saved selections and their same-cutoff leave-one-out reference, price, probability and EV.
Negative EV explicitly says price does not justify confidence. Equal-EV offers explicitly say tiebreak adds no conviction.
Key-margin outcomes are settlement arithmetic, not additional predictive evidence.
Methodology and other captured context are collapsed. Weather, Elo and QB context are not asserted as causal selection inputs.
No new data capture, model arithmetic, gate or historical-lock change. Week 2 has no new rationale.
least_sure: Whether explanatory text could imply unearned conviction. Explicitly separate offer ranking, line cushion, break-even price and weak/negative support; do not present weather or Elo as causes of these picks.
